A technique to convert a long beam estimator into a short beam estimator by treating the beam length sampling as a Russian Roulette (RR) decision on the contribution [S1].

The claim is explicitly stated and detailed in Source [S1]. Specifically, Section 7.3 ('PDFs of Long and Short Beams') states: 'Any long beam estimator can be converted to a corresponding short beam estimator by making a zero contribution whenever the beam is too short to make the considered contribution, else by the original estimator divided by the RR probability.' It further explains this as 'a new interpretation of short beams as a Russian roulette (RR) decision on the outcome of the long-beam estimator.' The notes also confirm this technique involves treating beam length sampling as an RR decision.
